title: U-2C and U-2R aircraft in flight
description: Black-and-white photograph of two dark U-2 variants flying in formation above patterned farmland, captioned "U-2C and U-2R." Chapter 5 text (page 252) compares the U-2R's J75/P-13B engine, altitude and speed with the U-2C, notes its $7.1 million unit cost, and discusses new camera requirements.
